--- matching all three passes (the converse of the case above) --- PASS Drivers republishes and all three re-agree
--- the OTHER half-completion: one package's own two feeds disagree (dual-publish gap) --- PASS coord-engine reached the org feed but nuget.org's push did not complete

--- fails CLOSED: an absent/empty/prerelease-only/unreadable subject is an ERROR, not a skip --- PASS a package missing from the org feed (404) fails, not skips PASS a package the feed serves zero versions for fails PASS a package with only prereleases on a feed fails (none of the three ever ships one) PASS an unreadable tag namespace (git ls-remote failure equivalent) fails

--- --remote is refused when it names a different repository (offline: checked before any read) --- PASS a --remote naming a different repository is refused before any network read
--- fixture mode announces itself, requires ALL THREE flags together, and is locked to this harness --- PASS fixture mode prints a banner PASS two of three fixture flags without the third refuses rather than reading one subject live PASS fixture flags refuse to run without FSGG_RELEASE_COHERENCE_FIXTURE_OK
